insights: The design uses a cohesive glassmorphism pattern with backdrop-blur and semi-transparent backgrounds across all buttons, creating depth against the dark navy canvas
Color-coded button variants (emerald for signup, yellow for login, rose for explore) provide clear visual hierarchy and purpose differentiation while maintaining consistent pill-shaped styling
Project cards implement a sophisticated hover interaction combining scale transform (1.03x), shadow elevation, and opacity-based overlay reveal for title text
